title: Speaking — Learning languages
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on learning languages.

questions: What did you last use your phone for?
When do you prefer to put your phone away?
Which phone feature do you find especially useful?
Has your phone changed how you arrange to meet people?
When do you use a language besides your first language?
Which part of language learning do you enjoy most?

part2.topic: Describe a time when knowing another language helped you.
part2.closing: and explain what the experience taught you about learning languages.

questions: What role should translation tools have in language classes?
Why do some communities place special value on keeping a local language alive?
How has everyday life connected with learning languages changed for people of different ages?
